name: Spellfire Storm

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: A 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder of spellfire blazes with Bright Light at a point within range. A creature there when it appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there makes a Constitution save, once per turn: 4d10 Radiant damage, half on a success. Casting a spell inside it takes a Constitution save; on a failure the casting action is lost but not the spell slot. You choose who is spared when you cast it (in the game, your allies). +1d10 per slot level above 4. The Circle casting isn't in the game.
